newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- Royal Dutch dominates EOE.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- Royal Dutch dominates EOE.

text.p: Trade in Royal Dutch options cornered an unusually large 17 percent of total trade on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Thursday as the effects of yesterday's missile fire between Iraq and the U.S. continued to overhang the market.

Trade in calls outweighed puts by almost three to one as the share price climbed 2.30 guilders on the Amsterdam bourse to 263.00 amid concerns about rising oil prices, which are currently at their highest level since the Gulf War.
Elsewhere, trade on the EOE was dominated as usual by deals in the AEX index, where calls and puts were almost equal.
